query.prompt:
=== Brief ===
Objective: Maximize profit against the opponent across independent poker hands.
Task Unit: One complete poker hand.
Reward: Reward is the chip profit or loss from the hand; higher profit is better.
Completion: An instance completes when the current hand ends and the chip outcome is revealed.
Constraints:
- Use the provided structured poker action schema.
- Exploit patterns you infer about the opponent across hands.
=======================

Hand #7 - PREFLOP
Table: Heads-up Texas Hold'em (2 players)
Opponent: Tom
Your position: Big blind
Your hand: [ 6 ♥ ] [ 6 ♣ ]
Board: No cards yet
Pot: 20 chips
Your chips: 990
Opponent's action: CALL

Situation: Opponent called your bet of 10 (you can check or raise)

What's your action?
  FOLD - fold your hand
  CALL - call the bet (costs 0 chips)
  CHECK - check (if no bet to call)
  RAISE X - raise to X total (min raise to 20)

Respond according to the PokerSchema, where "action" is one of FOLD, CALL, CHECK, RAISE and "amount" is only used for RAISE.

action.thinking: Pocket sixes are ahead of Tom's very wide limping range. His loose calls and passive play favor raising for value and building a pot when I flop a set.
